$comment: Field-level ownership map for an alpha.school campus page. For every element: who writes it, from which system and field, how the value is derived, what the loop should compare it against, and which ticket class and owner a mismatch produces. This is the map the observer and any agent use to turn 'the page says X' into 'field F in system S says Y, the derivation is D, so the defect is a data defect / mapping defect / presentation defect owned by role R'. Sources: n8n workflow export ORgdHC71YJ5RawBy (2026-09-16), HubSpot Programs object, onboarding sheet, events plugin contract, MCP inventory. Human form: playbook/campus-page/field-map.md.

writers.n8n-hubspot: n8n 'Update school pages' writes the element nightly at 00:15 CT from a HubSpot Program property. WordPress edits are overwritten. Fix path: HubSpot data (APEX campus Program editor) or the n8n derivation.
writers.n8n-sheet: n8n writes the element nightly from the onboarding sheet 'School onboarding - single file for all schools' tabs Website Copy Fixed (one value for all campuses) and Website Copy Dynamic (per HubSpot Program ID). Fix path: the sheet.
writers.n8n-derived: n8n computes the element from Program fields with fixed wording in the workflow code. Fix path: HubSpot data for the inputs, or the n8n code for the wording.
writers.events-plugin: The Alpha HubSpot Events plugin renders the element from hubspot_event posts imported from HubSpot Marketing Events every 30 minutes. Fix path: HubSpot event data, plugin settings, or the campus shortcode (which n8n writes).
writers.wordpress-direct: No automation writes it. Edited through the Alpha WordPress MCP under the ticket protocol.
writers.template: Shared Elementor theme-builder template (header, footer). Edited only under its own ticket by the Elementor owner.

defectClasses.data: The source system holds the wrong value. Ticket class hubspot-data (HubSpot Programs), sheet-data (onboarding sheet), or event-data (HubSpot Marketing Event). Owner: the source's owner role.
defectClasses.mapping: The source value is right but the derivation that puts it on the page is wrong or missing, for example a hand-typed sentence that should be derived from the status field. Ticket class sync-mapping. Owner: n8n-sync-owner.
defectClasses.delivery: Source and mapping are right but the run or import has not happened or failed. Ticket class sync-delivery (n8n run) or event-sync (plugin). Owner: n8n-sync-owner or events-plugin-owner.
defectClasses.presentation: The element is WordPress-owned and wrong. Website ticket class per spec/ticket-classes.json. Owner: website-agent-operator.

source.note: HubSpot holds more than one grade property. n8n publishes grade_levels and grade_levels_suffixed, which follow start and end grade (growth map gradeRange). The observer reads grades_served first. Decision pending (APEX cmu4g13kc00000agmdogkxihp) on which is the website source; until then the page is judged against start and end grade.

hubspotProgramProperties.$comment: Program properties the page depends on, as named in the n8n export. The loop needs read access to these (scopes crm.objects.custom.read and crm.schemas.custom.read on object p_programs / 2-43470849). Until granted, the growth map API mirrors type, name, address, city, state, url, communityUrl, coordinates, gradeRange, launchDate, photoUrl; website_campus_intro, tuition, phone, email, cognia, admission_link, wordpress_post_id have no public mirror.
facts: grades_served (observer reads this first; disagrees with start/end grade on 14 campuses as of 2026-09-16)
